property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the GridPreference (a Application or Document).

property.name: documentGridShown
property.shortdesc: If true, displays the document grid.

property.name: documentGridSnapto
property.shortdesc: If true, an object snaps to the nearest grid line when the object is created, moved, or resized.

property.name: horizontalGridlineDivision
property.shortdesc: The amount of space between major horizontal lines in the document grid.

property.name: verticalGridlineDivision
property.shortdesc: The amount of space between major vertical lines in the document grid.

property.name: horizontalGridSubdivision
property.shortdesc: The number of rows into which to subdivide the space between horizontal document grid lines.

property.name: verticalGridSubdivision
property.shortdesc: The number of columns into which to subdivide the space between vertical document grid lines.

property.name: gridColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the document grid, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255, representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: gridsInBack
property.shortdesc: If true, places grids behind all other objects on the spread.

property.name: baselineGridShown
property.shortdesc: If true, displays the baseline grid.

property.name: baselineStart
property.shortdesc: The amount to offset the baseline grid from the zero point.

property.name: baselineDivision
property.shortdesc: The amount of space between baseline grid lines.

property.name: baselineViewThreshold
property.shortdesc: The magnification (as a percentage) less than which ruler guides do not appear. (Range: 5 to 4000)

property.name: baselineColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the baseline grid, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255, representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. . Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: baselineGridRelativeOption
property.shortdesc: The zero point for the baseline grid offset.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the GridPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
